name: Kazakhstan

fees.name: Tourist visa (B12), single entry
fees.notes: Official consular fee schedule levied at Kazakh missions abroad; equivalents published as 50 EUR / 50 GBP / 60 CHF / 6,000 RUB / 385 CNY. No nationality-based variation in the schedule.

fees.name: Tourist visa, multiple entry
fees.notes: Equivalents: 80 EUR / 80 GBP / 90 CHF / 9,000 RUB / 580 CNY.

fees.name: Electronic visa (tourist/business/medical) via vmp.gov.kz
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (109 countries incl. IND, CHN)
fees.notes: Applied for on the Visa and Migration Portal (vmp.gov.kz); requires invitation number. Consular fee for the corresponding visa category is charged (tourist single-entry USD 60; standard/business single-entry USD 80 per consular fee schedule). Exact category fee shown at payment on the portal.

fees.name: Business/standard visa, single entry
fees.notes: Single-entry non-tourist/non-transit visa: 80 USD / 75 EUR / 75 GBP / 80 CHF / 8,000 RUB / 515 CNY. Multi-entry visas by duration range from USD 200 (1 year) to USD 1000 (5 years).

fees.name: Transit visa, single entry
fees.notes: Equivalents: 15 EUR / 15 GBP / 20 CHF / 2,000 RUB / 130 CNY. Multi-entry transit: USD 90.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (pre-arranged, at international airports)
fees.applies: nationals of countries with no Kazakh diplomatic mission, pre-approved invitation required
fees.notes: Available only as a pre-arranged visa issued at the airport; fee follows the standard consular fee schedule for the visa category. Exact published on-arrival amount not verified on an official page, so amount left null (third-party sources cite ~USD 80).

vfs.note: Kazakhstan does not route inbound visa applications through VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS; applications are made directly at embassies/consulates or online via the official Visa and Migration Portal (vmp.gov.kz). VFS Global centres in Kazakhstan handle outbound visas for other countries only.

free_visa_notes: Kazakhstan grants visa-free entry (typically 14-90 days) to nationals of roughly 80 countries, including USA, UK, Canada, EU states, China and (14 days) India; EAEU/CIS nationals such as Russians enter visa-free. For these travellers no visa fee applies for short stays. E-visa/consular fees above apply only to nationalities outside the visa-free list or for longer/other-purpose stays.
